review_type: independent source and static write-surface review; script not executed
disposition: clear for the separately authorized operator action after fenced abandonment and fresh exact-state review
verified_guards: Exact reviewed canonical state hash and no active deployment lease
Original policy must still be two hours
The exact first failed promotion must be recorded as abandoned and the existing live predecessor must remain unchanged
Operator identity is required; preparation and execution workflow roles are refused
Existing full healthy runtime boundary is checked read-only
Prospective six-hour-shortened successor with two task-hours must pass the existing canonical budget validator at the current clock
Prospective reservation is not written to the ledger
Private immutable before/after receipt is written before the state CAS, under the bucket-policy-enforced promotions prefix
The conditional state write changes only the shortening policy plus one revision increment
Readback must equal the complete expected state, preserving ledger history, money, caps, identities, aliases and runtime configuration
No automatic retry after an unknown outcome; subsequent application fails the original-policy guard

finding_resolved.finding: Initial receipt path was outside the bucket-policy-enforced immutable prefix.
finding_resolved.resolution: Final reviewed script stores the receipt below promotions/ with If-None-Match, matching the installed immutable-write policy.

limits: This is approval of the reviewed source scope, not evidence that the policy has been applied.
The six-hour shortening remains the future default until another explicit idle-state review changes it; there is no automatic reset.
Current service counts, schedules and runtime remain unchanged by this policy-only action. The next promotion approval displays its calculated expiry.
Operational stderr and the detailed local result must remain private; the success projection contains hashes, expiry and cost totals only.
